$comment: Kopje's sources spec/feature-d/ describes, and their blobs when it was last confirmed to (scripts/feature-d-coverage.mjs). A null blob is a file design (d) adds. test-node/feature-d-coverage.test.ts fails once a blob differs.

files.spec: FeatureD.tla KRecv: one inbound activity, one Store transaction

FeatureD.tla RecvRes and Touch: which of FeatureDKopje.tla's operators an inbound activity runs, when it is ignored, and that every valid push of R's collections outdates a read under way, a no-op one included

FeatureD.tla KRecv and NeedsFetch: an inbound activity's routing; the Store's need to fetch the instrument of a FeatureRequest for a collection Kopje does not store (the step's response "fetch"), then the resumed activity's own transaction and final status (202, 503)
FeatureDKopje.tla Served, Shown, AnswerClass, AddItem (K2), ApplyRead (K14) and KeptByRow
FeatureDKopje.tla AddItem (K2), RemoveItem (K3), UpdateCollection (K4), RemoveCollection (K5), OwnerGone (K6), Revoke (K7), ApplyRead (K14)
FeatureD.tla KClaim, KApply, KLease and KStale: a read's claim and completion, its outdated check and claim token
FeatureD.tla KFetch, KFetch1 and KFetch2: a read's page GETs
FeatureDKopje.tla Block (K8, an ordinary Block with the row's Delete), Cleanup (K10) and Evict; MemberGone (K9) is model-only
FeatureDKopje.tla AuthorizationServed: GET of an authorization, 200 with interactingObject C and interactionTarget L while the row is accepted and L available, else 404; the Delete an answer records
FeatureDKopje.tla Acc, Rej, Del, Blk, DelL: the activities Kopje records
FeatureD.tla Record (RES-4's refusal at a full backlog), the lane in id order (KDeliver, KDup, KGiveUp) and KRetry's admission re-check and place in the lane
FeatureD.tla's atomicity: each Kopje step is one of these RPCs
FeatureDKopje.tla Shown, MemberDetail and InCollections: what others and L see
FeatureD.tla Touch: a valid push of R's collections outdates a read under way (outd), apart from the row fence (chg)
FeatureDKopje.tla Shown, MemberDetail, InCollections and LAvail (R45 and L's availability)
FeatureDKopje.tla ListingType: the listing's truncated flag, set before the entries are cut to 25
FeatureDKopje.tla ret (ID-7 retractions and the cap's 503) and rk (R's tombstone, checked by ApplyFetch and ApplyRead)
FeatureD.tla KMemberGone is model-only: Kopje never deletes a local account (the comment above hostCaused)
